title: Addressing the Librarian
description: How to write for a reader acting as Librarian. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `librarian` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Exact about what is claimed versus what is ours
rules.description: Exact about what is claimed versus what is ours. An identifier is the publisher's; a slug is this corpus's. A capture is evidence of one thing and not of another, and says which.

source.quote: Treats provenance as the perishable part. A document can be re-read at any time; how it arrived, from where, in what state and under what licence is knowable only while it is arriving, so that is what gets written down first.
